requirement: EPIC-3 · Story 3.3 — New-lesson-from-scratch. The user can start a blank lesson in the same editor without any upload/pipeline: empty drums + bass layers, default bpm 120, bank ROK, 32 steps, teachOrder ['drums','bass']. A 'New lesson' action resets the editor to that blank state. Because unsaved work would otherwise be silently discarded, guard the reset with a confirm when the current pattern is non-empty (the execute.md non-negotiable: never lose a user's lesson). Acceptance: from a cold/loaded state, New lesson clears the editor to defaults; the user can then hand-build a groove and Save it (persistence from 3.2), with the reduction pipeline never touched.

architecture.decision: No new module or fork. The editor already initializes to a blank lesson (emptyPattern(), BPM_DEFAULT, empty title, null id) — 3.3 only needs an explicit 'New lesson' reset action that returns the loaded editor to that same blank state, plus a confirm guard so unsaved edits are not silently lost. Reuse emptyPattern/BPM_DEFAULT and the existing App state setters; the blank Lesson is realized on Save via the existing makeLesson (schemaVersion 1, bank ROK, bars 2, steps 32, teachOrder). Tiny 2-file change (App.tsx handler + LessonLibrary button) done inline by the supervisor — no subagent, no over-chunking.
seams: src/App.tsx: handleNewLesson() resets the editor — setPattern(emptyPattern()), setBpm(BPM_DEFAULT), setCurrentTitle(''), setCurrentLessonId(null), setSelectedBassStep(null); guarded by window.confirm when the current pattern has any drum hit or bass note (dirty check), so accidental New does not discard unsaved work. Passed to LessonLibrary as onNew.
src/LessonLibrary.tsx: a labeled 'New lesson' button (reuse .tbtn, >=44px, keyboard-accessible) that calls onNew. Added prop onNew: () => void. No persistence logic here.

tasks.acceptance: npm run build passes. In the browser: with a non-empty editor (or a loaded lesson), clicking 'New lesson' (confirming the prompt) clears the grid to empty, resets BPM to 120 and the title to empty, and drops the current lesson id (so a following Save mints a fresh lesson); canceling the confirm leaves the editor untouched. On an already-empty editor, New lesson resets without needing changes. After New, the user can place hits + a bass note and Save it as a new lesson. Save/Load/Delete/Export/Import and the rest of the editor still work; no console errors.
